author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In the last two sci-fi short stories, AGI believes in Jesus and Buddhism
In this sci-fi, the AGI believes in Muslim.
I chat with GPT to write this story. The plot development is totally out of my expectation. I started off trying to a humorous piece like the last two, but it turns out have a classic sci-fi poetic ending.
